distribution.summary: 黑龙江；吉林；陕西；四川；云南
distribution.narrative: The broader baseline distribution (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan) is retained. Wang et al. (2021) examined Jilin and Sichuan material and therefore confirms part of, rather than replaces, the baseline range.

host_note: Baseline host synthesis is retained; Wang et al. (2021) directly reports Pinus koraiensis and P. armandii, both already included in the synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips sexdentatus (Boerner, 1776).
